caption: An underwater torch is switched on in murky water, and a cone of lit particles appears in front of it.

sa.check: An underwater torch is in murky water.
A cone of lit particles appears in front of it.

pc.expect: The lit cone points where the torch points, fades with distance, and moves with the torch.
pc.fail: The cone points elsewhere; or is even to its end; or stays put while the torch moves.

pc.expect: The cone appears with the switch and moves only with the torch.
pc.fail: It is there with the torch off; or drifts with the torch still; or flickers.

pc.expect: The cone is one soft-edged beam of lit particles.
pc.fail: It is a sharp rod; or splits; or floods the whole water.

pc.expect: The particles drift slowly in the water.
pc.fail: They are rigid and still; or shoot about; or the water is clear with a visible beam.
A second cone appears; or the torch vanishes; or the beam becomes solid.

pc.expect: The water's colour and the torch stay the same.
pc.fail: The water changes colour; or the torch changes; or the beam changes colour.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged. Illumination: the on/off causality of electric lights belongs to Electricity; here only where the light goes once it exists is judged.
